## Sound not yet in the library

Three effects this cut wants and `../kannada/tools/sfx/` does not hold. Source them, archive the licence evidence on the day of download, add the row to `Kannada-sfx-licence-log.csv`, then place them.

| Effect | Shot | Why | Search |
|---|---|---|---|
| Steel plate set down, single, soft | `S08` | One plate meeting a stone floor, dry, no ring-out. Currently unscored. | [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/search/metal%20plate/) |
| Car boot closing, distant | `S20` | Faint realism under the supplies load. No engine, no alarm chirp. | [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/search/car%20ambience/) |
| Gentle warm chime, non-electronic | `S30` | To replace the piano note on the end card if a warmer resolve is wanted. Must not sound like a phone notification. | [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/search/gentle%20chime/) |

Until they are sourced, `S08` carries no accent, `S20` carries the zip alone, and `S30` resolves on the piano note.
